subject: [PATCH v5 32/36] mm/khugepaged: base private node collapse eligiblity on actor/cap bits

reviews.author: Richard Cheng
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with collapse_scan_file() needing a similar check as folio_allows_collapse(). Gregory acknowledged the point and thanked Richard for it.

2026-07-22.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new function, folio_allows_collapse(), which determines whether a folio can be collapsed into a THP based on the actor calling it and the node's capabilities. The function is used to isolate private nodes from khugepaged and MADV_COLLAPSE operations. The patch also updates various functions in mm/khugepaged.c to use this new function.
